blocking_findings.evidence: scripts/mros/population_git_trust.py:100-101 accepts a receipt when `git merge-base --is-ancestor freeze origin` succeeds. This accepts an origin commit descending from the freeze commit, including receipts created after the population was frozen. The R005 repair contract explicitly requires post-freeze receipt creation to fail closed.
blocking_findings.falsifier: Create the manifest in commit F, create a valid receipt in descendant commit R, and run load_exact_receipts with QUEUE_REF at R. The current implementation accepts the receipt instead of emitting a provenance error.
blocking_findings.recommended_repair_scope: Require the receipt origin commit to be an ancestor of the manifest freeze commit, or verify the receipt path exists in the freeze commit tree; add a regression test for a newly created post-freeze receipt and an independently modified post-freeze receipt.
blocking_findings.requirement: Every receipt must be proven to exist at or before the frozen population manifest commit; post-freeze receipt creation must fail closed.

blocking_findings.evidence: scripts/mros/program_context.py::validate_acceptance_trace validates only schema_version, sprint, candidate_head, authority/runtime/M9 labels, criterion status, and non-empty string evidence_refs. scripts/mros/advance_program.py::load_and_validate_context does not compare trace criterion IDs or evidence_refs with S003_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.json or load/hash the referenced evidence. authorize() separately loads only acceptance IDs from the frozen contract for audit coverage, so an attacker-controlled all-PASS acceptance trace with arbitrary criterion IDs/evidence_refs can pass context validation and remain part of the advancement input.
blocking_findings.falsifier: Provide a structurally valid acceptance trace for S003 with all criteria marked PASS but substitute criterion IDs and nonexistent or unrelated evidence_refs; authorization must reject it specifically for contract-ID and evidence-resolution/provenance mismatches.
blocking_findings.recommended_repair_scope: Bind acceptance-trace criteria exactly to the frozen S003 acceptance contract, reject missing/extra/duplicate IDs, resolve each evidence_ref from an approved repository root, verify existence and immutable content identity, and fail closed on stale, nonexistent, or unrelated evidence.
blocking_findings.requirement: Advancement must validate the supplied acceptance trace against the frozen S003 acceptance contract and resolve or cryptographically verify every referenced evidence artifact.

root_cause_instruction: Cluster related findings and repair common causes once; preserve adaptive routine assurance and explicit full-board authority boundaries.
